Question 1 (a) Compute the outer product M ⊗ N of the following two matrices: [9 marks] M = ( 0 1 7 2 ) and N =   1 0 1 −1 −1 2   . (b) Suppose Tijkℓ is a rank-four tensor. [8 marks] (i) Write down the transformation rule of Tijkℓ. (ii) Using the transformation rule, show that Tijij is a scalar. (c) Let u, v, w, and z be vectors in R 3. Using suffix notation, find an expression [8 marks] involving no cross products for (u × (v × w)) · z. Write your final answer in vector notation. Provide all steps of your workings. Answers: (a) M ⊗ N =        0 0 1 0 0 0 1 −1 0 0 −1 2 7 0 2 0 7 −7 2 −2 −7 14 −2 4        (b)(i) T ′ ijkℓ = LimLjnLkpLℓqTmnpq. (b)(ii) No numerical solution. (c) (u · w)(v · z) − (u · v)(w · z). 1

Question 2 In this question, denote by K the Cartesian coordinate system with vector basis i1, i2, i3, the standard orthonormal basis of R3. Denote by K ′ the coordinate system with vector basis e1, e2, e3 given by e1 = 2i1 + i3 e2 = i2 e3 = i1 − i2 + i3. (a) Find the dual basis e1, e2, e3. [8 marks] (b) Find the covariant and contravariant components of the vector V = 3i1−2i2+i3 [8 marks] with respect to the bases e1, e2, e3 and e 1, e2, e3. (c) Consider the second-order tensor of K with components [9 marks] [Pik] = [P ik] = [P ·k i ] = [P i ·k] =   0 2 0 3 0 −1 −1 0 1   . Express the covariant components of the given tensor in the coordinate system K ′. Answers: (a) e1 = ( 1 0 −1 ) e2 = ( −1 1 2 ) e3 = ( −1 0 2 ) . (b) V1 = 7, V2 = −2, V3 = 6. V 1 = 2, V 2 = −3, V 3 = −1. (c)  −1 4 −4 5 0 2 −6 2 −4   . Academic year 2023/24 Page 2 of 5

# Page 3^page=3
Question 3 Consider the three-dimensional orthogonal coordinate system (x1, x 2, x 3) = (σ, τ, ϕ) with position r given by r = στ i1 + 1 2(σ2 − τ 2)i2 + ϕi3, where i1, i2, i3 are the usual Cartesian basis vectors. (a) Compute the basis vectors e1, e2, e3 of this coordinate system. [9 marks] (b) Compute the metric coefficients of the arc length and the components of the [8 marks] covariant metric tensor gii for the parabolic coordinate system. (c) Determine the following Christoffel symbols of the first kind for the parabolic [8 marks] coordinate system: Γ112, Γ123, Γ122, Γ233. Answers: (a) e1 = τ i1 + σi2 e2 = σi1 − τ i2 e3 = i3. (b) (ds) 2 = (σ2 + τ 2)(dσ) 2 + (σ2 + τ 2)(dτ )2 + (dϕ) 2. and h1 = √σ2 + τ 2, h2 = √σ2 + τ 2, h3 = 1. (c) Γ112 = τ, Γ123 = 0, Γ122 = −σ, Γ233 = 0. Academic year 2023/24 Page 3 of 5

Question 4 (a) The third-rank tensor Tijk is symmetric with respect to its last two suffixes but [8 marks] antisymmetric with respect to its first and second suffices. Show that all entries of this tensor are zero (i.e. Tijk = 0, for all choices of i,j,k). (b) Let Vi be a (non-constant) covariant tensor. That is, it transforms according to [8 marks] the rule V ′ i = L k i′Vk. Prove that ∂Vi ∂xj is not a tensor, i.e. that it does not satisfy the transformation law of a tensor. You may use the formulas L k i′ = ∂xk ∂x′i , L i′ k = ∂x′i ∂xk . (c) Let f be a scalar field. Using suffix notation, evaluate the following expression [9 marks] ∇ × (∇f ). Answers: (a) No numerical solution. (b) No numerical solution. (c) No numerical solution. Academic year 2023/24 Page 4 of 5
